corrected_fields.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corporation and subsidiary MPLX LP entered into new revolving credit agreements on April 7, 2026, replacing their respective 2022 credit facilities. MPC's new facility is $5.0 billion over five years; MPLX's is $2.5 billion over five years. No borrowings were outstanding under the prior agreements. MPC had $2.2 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of March 31, 2026; MPLX held $1.5 billion of that amount.
